_doc: Per-model settings for tests/run_shipped_models.py (see tests/README.md). tier: fast (every PR), slow (manual / push to main), local (never in CI; needs a tier_reason), skip (never run; needs a reason). heavy: run alone, never in parallel. Overrides: weather (passed as -w), max_unmet_heating_hours, max_unmet_cooling_hours, zone_temp_limits_c ({zone: [lo, hi]}); each override needs a matching <key>_reason.

examples/chiller_table_curves.yaml.max_unmet_heating_hours_reason: 2223 h measured building-wide, about 10% margin. The example hard-sizes its equipment (no design days) to demonstrate table chiller curves; its 20 kW electric reheat can't hold 21 C in cold hours (zone down to 9 C). An example input, not an engine limit (#328).

examples/doe_retail_standalone.yaml.max_unmet_heating_hours_reason: 428 h measured building-wide at the IDF's 0.556 K reporting tolerance (OutputControl:ReportingTolerances); E+ 25.2 reports 459.5 h for the same IDF (facility Time Setpoint Not Met), about half in the entry vestibule while its heater is locked out above 7.2 C; about 10% margin.
examples/doe_retail_standalone.yaml.max_unmet_cooling_hours_reason: 448 h measured building-wide at the IDF's 0.556 K tolerance with the IDF's daylight saving (#199), about 10% margin; E+ 25.2 reports 425.25 h for the same IDF. Night and evening hours just above the 23.89 C no-setback cooling setpoint inside the night cycle's tolerance; daylight saving ends the HVAC schedule an hour earlier in solar time, so more warm evening hours fall on the night cycle.

examples/multi_year_parametric.yaml.weather_reason: Its 10 Denver AMY files (2015-2024) aren't available; one TMY3 year still exercises the parametric runs.

examples/office_vrf.yaml.max_unmet_heating_hours_reason: 104 h measured building-wide (any conditioned zone unmet), with indoor-unit airflow from the zone design flow (#327); about 10% margin; the baseline flags any change.

examples/retail_rtu.yaml.max_unmet_heating_hours_reason: 2557 h measured building-wide, about 10% margin: nearly all in the 12 m2 Office, a zone on the Sales Area's thermostat with no zone control of its own, which gets its design share of the unit's air (E+ terminal maximum flows, #389). E+ counts such a zone the same way; giving it control is a change to the example, not the engine.
examples/retail_rtu.yaml.max_unmet_cooling_hours_reason: 1134 h measured building-wide, about 10% margin: nearly all in the 12 m2 Office (no zone control; its design share of the air, #389).

examples/simple_heating.yaml.max_unmet_heating_hours_reason: 744 h measured building-wide, about 10% margin: all in the Conference Room, which has its own thermostat but no zone control on the PSZ that East Office controls, and gets its design share of the air (0.20 of 1.05 kg/s, E+ terminal maximum flows, #389). Recorded on #328.

prototype_tests/hospital/Hospital_STD202.tier_reason: Needs more memory than a GitHub runner has: the 55-zone transcription of the DOE Hospital IDF peaked at 18.4 GB RSS locally (2026-11-15) against the 16 GB ubuntu-latest runner. Run locally, alone, with --tier local before merging engine changes.

Run locally, alone, with --tier local before merging engine changes.
prototype_tests/large_office/LargeOffice.max_unmet_heating_hours_reason: 2283 h measured building-wide at the IDF's 0.556 K reporting tolerance, about 10% margin. E+ 25.2 reports 708 h for the same IDF (eplus_run/eplustbl.csv); the gap is traced on #328 (LargeOffice VAV and plant comparison).
prototype_tests/large_office/LargeOffice.max_unmet_cooling_hours_reason: 4407 h measured building-wide at the IDF's 0.556 K reporting tolerance, about 10% margin, mostly the core zones. E+ 25.2 reports 1,992 h for the same IDF; the gap is traced on #328 (LargeOffice VAV and plant comparison).

prototype_tests/single_family/SingleFami.zone_temp_limits_c_reason: The unconditioned vented attic peaks at 68.4 °C in a Boulder summer, which is physical for an attic under a sunlit roof. Every other zone keeps the default limits.
The unconditioned vented attic peaks at 68.4 °C in a Boulder summer, which is physical for an attic under a sunlit roof. Every other zone keeps the default limits.
